findings.reason: The evidence shows correlation (spikes in traffic, PRB, and latency) but does not prove causation or saturation as the root cause.
ANM-000168 and ANM-000169 explicitly state the spikes to 565 active users and 36591 MB downlink volume.
T7 lists max prb_util_pct as 99.4 and max latency_ms as 128 for S-TUN-005.
T7 shows low PRB utilization (max ~28%) and stable latency (max ~37ms) for S-TUN-003 and S-TUN-006.
T5 explicitly reports no changes on S-TUN-005 and its ancestors in the specified window.
T8 explicitly reports no maintenance windows on S-TUN-005 and its ancestors in the specified window.
